events.why: the lab gate needs five species, 3 after the tutorial: catch Scatterbug (road, marker 100) and Mareep (grass, 60). Off Taunie's rocks, checked by the map pin, then patrol 100, 60, ... (going to 100 respawns 60); 10 visits, 10 min, 12 throws at most. The party bar's count decides (5 = done), since the "Registered!" banner can be missed

metadata.source: played from a new game; starts at 03.07's autosave at Taunie's rocks, ends on the last catch's autosave (03.08b walks out). The lead's panel alone does not tell the zone from the street; party 3 does
